entries.title: Algorithmic Art supplied-snapshot adaptation
uses: Create seeded procedural artwork and interactive exploration in browser Canvas or SVG. Use for flow fields, particle systems, generative patterns, and reproducible visual variants rather than static graphic layout or encoded video.
